evidence.quote: Table 11 row 43: Total Investments | $ | 8,595,040 | $ | 8,632,315 | 206.2 | % (amounts in thousands; amortized cost, fair value, and percentage of net assets).

Fair value hierarchy table 28 row 8: Total investments at fair value | $ | - | $ | 196,925 | $ | 8,435,390 | $ | 8,632,315 (amounts in thousands).

rationale: The March 31, 2026 schedule of investments has a final Total Investments row with fair value of $8,632,315 thousand. The same amount appears on the balance sheet and in the fair value hierarchy, so it is the grand total rather than a schedule subtotal. It is 97.18% of total assets of $8,882,960 thousand, leaving a plausible non-investment remainder of $250,645 thousand. Companyfacts captured the complete grand total; the filing separately shows $8,624,980 thousand of non-controlled, non-affiliated investments and $7,335 thousand of non-controlled, affiliated investments, which sum to the reported total.
